variants.advanced: Build comprehensive cohort analysis dashboard. Cohort table structure: rows are cohorts (grouped by signup date/month), columns are time periods after cohort start (Week 1, Week 2, etc.), cells show metric value (retention %, revenue, activity). Color coding: heatmap coloring (light to dark green for high retention), configurable color scale. Cell values: percentage for retention, absolute values for other metrics, hover tooltip for full details. Cohort definition: default by signup date, custom cohorts (first purchase, feature adoption), cohort size shown in first column. Metrics: retention rate (% still active), average revenue per user, conversion rate, any custom event. Time granularity: daily (first 14 days), weekly, monthly, configurable. Column display: show actual dates or relative periods. Trend lines: toggle row charts showing cohort trend, average line across all cohorts. Comparison: highlight selected cohort vs average, compare two cohorts side by side. Filters: filter users in cohorts by segment (channel, plan, location). Statistical significance: indicate if differences are significant. Export: download cohort table as CSV, or as image. Benchmarks: show target retention rates as reference. Insights: auto-generate text insights about trends. Drill down: click cell to see users in that cohort/period, user list with actions. Time range: select analysis period, update cohort inclusion. Predictions: project future cohort performance based on patterns. Mobile: scrollable table with frozen first column.
